# Market brief — Tuesday 2026-10-06 7:30 ET

## Calendar — next 5 market days (chronological)
**Tue 2026-10-06**
- 08:30 ET — International trade (Aug; prior about −$88.6B) — external balance. Not printed as of 7:30 ET.
- no CPI, claims, or Fed print today

**Wed 2026-10-07**
- 14:00 ET — FOMC minutes (Sep 15–16 meeting) — hike-path debate
- 15:00 ET — Consumer credit (Aug; prior about +$18.1B) — household credit

**Thu 2026-10-08**
- 08:30 ET — Initial jobless claims (week of Oct 3; last cited prior 197k) — labor softness check
- 10:00 ET — Wholesale inventories (Aug final) — stock build

**Fri 2026-10-09**
- 10:00 ET — U. of Michigan sentiment, prelim Oct (one calendar: cons. 47.6 vs prior 47.8) — household mood
- 10:00 ET — UMich inflation expectations (prior cited 4.6%) — inflation survey

**Mon 2026-10-12**
- Columbus Day — cash equities open, bonds closed — no major prints

Already printed, not in this window: Fri Oct 2 NFP +29k vs cons. ~84–90k, unemployment 4.2% vs 4.1%, AHE +0.13% MoM / +3.0% YoY; Jul–Aug revised −60k combined (BLS). Mon Oct 5 ISM services 54.9 vs prior 55.4; prices index 74.0. No ADP, CPI, PPI, GDP, or Fed decision in these five sessions. Next CPI Wed Oct 14 08:30; PPI and retail sales Thu Oct 15 08:30. Monthly equity OPEX Fri Oct 16; VIX expiration Wed Oct 21. Next FOMC decision Wed Oct 28 (no SEP). No voting-FOMC speech reconfirmed on the Fed calendar for this window.

## Stock / catalysts — next 30 days
**2026-10-07 to 2026-10-08** — ISA / deep-sea — webinar on environmental threshold values for activities in the Area — confirmed — on published agenda — https://isa.org.jm/news/isa-to-host-webinar-on-the-development-of-environmental-threshold-values/
**Window through Oct 2026** — TMC — NOAA certification of USA-A — estimated — Q2 call target; not a dated Federal Register day.
**Window overlapping next 30d** — ASTS — BlueBird 14–16 left Midland for Cape Canaveral; arrays on BB11–13 reported nominal — inferred — company/press shipping note, no company or SpaceX NET. Fan “end-October launch” is not a company date.
**2026-10-16** — IWM / index options — monthly equity OPEX — confirmed — third Friday; not a company event.
**2026-10-21** — VIX — monthly VIX expiration — confirmed — market structure.
**2026-10-27 to 2026-10-28** — FOMC — rate decision, no SEP — confirmed — Fed calendar; topic may arise for rates, not ASTS/TMC.
**2026-10-29 to 2026-10-30** — BoJ — policy meeting and Outlook Report — confirmed — topic may arise for USDJPY.
ASTS: no dated launch, FCC, or earnings event found in 30d. Q3 estimates sit in November, outside this window.
TMC: $11.50 public and private warrants expired 2026-09-09 and are not live. No Korea Zinc, Project Crucible, vessel, or Allseas date inside 30d. Crucible FONSI was Sep 11.

## Insiders — recently reported (ASTS, TMC)
Lookback is filing dates on or after 2026-09-22. No open-market buys.

ASTS
- Wayne Thorsen, EVP and CCO — RSU grant, code A, not a purchase — 200,000 Class A at $0 — remaining direct 200,000 — txn 2026-09-28, filed 2026-10-01.
- Prior sales are outside the 14d filing window: Yao (CTO) 10b5-1 sale 40,000 at $58.93 and Gupta (COO) sale 12,000 at $58.89, both txn 2026-09-16, filed 2026-09-17.
No ASTS Form 144 found in the window.

TMC: no Form 4/144 in last 14d. Last Form 4 was Hall (director) RSU grant 72,935, txn 2026-09-11, filed 2026-09-16 — outside the window. No open-market TMC buy or sale in the window.

## Rates and bonds
Monday New York close: 10y about 5.31% (+3.5 bp on the day), 2y about 4.83% (+0.6 bp); 10y–2y about +48 bp, not inverted (Yonhap Infomax, 15:00 ET). Early Tuesday FT table: 10y 5.27%, 2y 4.81% — yields dipped from the multi-decade highs (10y had tagged ~5.34% last week; 30y ~5.66–5.67%). Week change on the 10y is roughly flat to a few bp lower versus the Oct 1 area near 5.32–5.33%. FRED Oct 5: 5y breakeven 2.36%, 5y5y forward 2.36%. 5y TIPS real yield not freshly sourced this morning; 10y breakeven not pulled as a same-day print. Soft payrolls did not break the long end; services prices at 74 keep the inflation side alive into Wednesday’s minutes. Fed funds target remains 3.75–4.00% after the Sep 16 +25 bp hike.

## USD/JPY
Spot about 158.22 at 06:29 ET (MarketWatch), +0.31 / +0.20% vs a 157.91 prior close; day range 157.77–158.25. FT table also 158.18. Short trend is a grind higher from mid-September ~153–155 toward the 160 chatter line; pair was ~157.4 at end-September. No fresh confirmed intervention. BoJ meets Oct 29–30. US long yields easing overnight is the near offset to yen weakness.

## Equities tape
SPX 7,773.95 Monday (+0.66%), within about 0.3% of the summer all-time high (AP). Nasdaq composite 27,477.31 (+1.05%), a record close. NDX about 31,076 (+0.87%). QQQ last cited 756.20 Monday. Russell 2000 2,847.14 (+0.50%). IWM options page fetched 06:55 ET showed 283.38 (+0.7% vs a prior near 281); treat as pre-open/last cited, not an official close. At 05:50 ET, Dow futures +0.55%, S&P futures +0.25% (about 7,797), Nasdaq 100 futures +0.33% (Reuters). Breadth: % above 50d/200d and NH/NL not sourced; equal-weight vs cap-weight not sourced this morning — best proxy is Nasdaq/SPX leadership on Monday versus a smaller Russell gain. VIX 15.52 Monday close (+0.21); Oct VIX futures about 17.2 — mid, not stress.

## Names / themes only if material overnight
No ASTS or TMC headline, filing, or outsized move found overnight. BB14–16 “en route” is an Oct 3 report, not a new tape event. Oil softer and yields off the highs were the index inputs.

- S&P futures +0.25% at 05:50 ET as yields and oil dip — https://ae.marketscreener.com/news/wall-st-futures-rise-as-yields-oil-dip-ce785dd8d08cf725
- USDJPY ~158.2, with 160 still the intervention-chatter line into the Oct 29–30 BoJ meeting.
- Wednesday 14:00 ET FOMC minutes are the next rates event; today’s 08:30 trade balance is second-tier — https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomcpresconf20260916.htm
